Subject: Quick recap + next steps from today's call

Samir / Priya — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from my side: 

- Goals: reduce inference cost on your batch scoring pipeline and get predictable 99th percentile latency for customer-facing requests.
- Current infra: mixed on-prem + GCP infra, heavy use of V100s for model serving.
- Key constraints: SOC2 evidence required, strict data retention window, and low-change window for production.

Proposed next steps (ASAP):
1) Technical deep-dive with Nikhil (SE) to size expected throughput and discuss quantization/latency tradeoffs. I suggested a 60–90 min session with logs and sample payloads.
2) Security/compliance sync to validate audit/log requirements (we can pull docs).
3) We can prepare a short pilot (2-week) scoped in an SOW — attached is a rough SOW template for reference.

Can you confirm who else on your side we should include (infra owner / legal)? If the above looks right, I can loop in Nikhil for scheduling.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOW-template.docx (docx, 42KB)]

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz

Vanessa — happy to help. Draft bullets below (feel free to paste):

- Volume & latency targets: we'll validate expected QPS and recommend configuration to reach your 99th % latency SLO (typical gains: 2–5x latency improvement using continuous batching + KV cache).
- Model optimization options: we can demo a quantized variant (int8/4bit) that reduces GPU memory and cost with minimal quality regression; we'll show metric comparisons on a sample payload set.
- Data/inputs needed: sample inference payloads + production sequence-length distribution plus a short set of non-sensitive logs (no PII) to size mem/cache.

I can turn this into a 2-slide tech brief if that helps before the call.

— Nikhil

Vanessa / Nikhil — adding the CS perspective. Top onboarding risks and mitigations:

1) Security/compliance evidence lag — mitigation: share SOC2 summary and audit log extract; offer a short compliance checklist call with our security engineer.
2) Data movement and access — mitigation: we can run an agentless pilot (bring-your-own-enclave) or use VPC connectors; outline options in the kickoff.
3) Production rollback/monitoring — mitigation: include canary rollout and automated fallback to existing endpoint; we provide tracing hooks for early detection.

I'll attach a short product overview you can include in the external bump.
